scares.description: A cat jumps up from the other side of the window that Michael is looking through.
The possessed girl suddenly grabs Michael around the neck.
During a dream, an unseen person grabs Michael around the neck.
Father Lucas suddenly hits a young girl.
Accompanied by a loud sound effect, Father Lucas appears behind Michael.
Accompanied by a loud sound effect, Father Lucas’ hands are pulled back by an unseen force.
Father Lucas suddenly leaps from the chair and attacks Angelina.
